fields.Name: Party Orders Overview
fields.UserQuestion: What is this person or organization's complete order overview — counts, LTV, monthly trajectory, recent orders, and active subscriptions?
fields.Description: Single-query optimization for the Person and Organization form Overview section. Returns all figures, 6-month spend trajectory, top 6 recent orders, and top 4 active subscriptions in one round trip using JSON aggregation.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Nunjucks-parameterized. PartyKind (person|organization) selects the bill-to / subscription join column; PartyID is the party UUID and is always passed through the sqlString filter. Aggregates __mj_BizAppsOrders.vwOrderHeaders and vwSubscriptions with nested JSON arrays for RecentOrdersJson, ActiveSubscriptionsJson, and MonthlyTrajectoryJson.
